caption: The drawing depicts a person standing with one arm raised and the other extended outward. The individual has short, tousled brown hair, and their skin tone is light. They are wearing a blue vest with gold trim over a long-sleeved white shirt that has a slight sheen and puffy sleeves. There is a ruffled pink collar at the neck. Around the waist, the person has a blue belt with circular decorations. The trousers are orange with a pattern of small circular shapes in various colors, and they are slightly flared and end just below the knees. The hem of the trousers is adorned with small round gold decorations. The person is also wearing white stockings and black shoes with small heels. The background is plain and ivory-colored, and the name "Pearl Torell" is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Puppet - "Tight Rope Walker"
